title: નવરાત્રિ
caption: Nine nights, double the crowd, and no idea what is in the drawer. Lumi tells Bhavini's Navratri in Gujarati.
linkedin_text:
Navratri doubles the footfall at small shops in Gujarat and leaves most owners guessing what the nine nights actually earned.

ScoreMyBiz turns the shop's own book into one number for its health and three moves for the week. Lumi tells Bhavini's story in Gujarati with English subtitles; every screen is the real app in Gujarati.

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a festive red and green chaniya choli with a bandhani dupatta, stands in a lane of Gujarati shops lit for Navratri, string lights and lanterns, turns to the camera with a bright smile.
scenes.vo: નમસ્તે, હું લૂમી છું. વાત છે નવરાત્રિની. નવ રાત, નવ રંગ, અને ભાવિનીની દુકાન મોડી રાત સુધી ખુલ્લી.
scenes.sub: Hi, I'm Lumi. This is a Navratri story. Nine nights, nine colours, and Bhavini's shop open till late.
scenes.title: નવરાત્રિ

scenes.clip: a lane of small shops in Ahmedabad on a Navratri night: string lights, a chaniya choli shop glowing, a snack stall busy with young people in garba dress, music in the air, slow push-in.
scenes.vo: ગરબા પછી ભીડ સીધી દુકાને આવે છે. વેચાણ ડબલ. પણ ગલ્લામાં હિસાબ? એ ખબર નથી.
scenes.sub: After garba the crowd comes straight to the shop. Sales double. But what is in the drawer? No idea.

scenes.clip: {bhavini} jotting quickly in a phone at her busy snack counter at night, customers in garba dress waiting, lights overhead, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: સ્કોર માય બિઝમાં ભાવિની ફટાફટ નોંધે છે: વેચ્યું, ખરીદ્યું, ખર્ચ્યું. બાકીનું બધું ઍપ સંભાળે.
scenes.sub: In ScoreMyBiz Bhavini jots it down fast: Sold, Bought, Spent. The app handles the rest.

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a festive red and green chaniya choli with a bandhani dupatta, beside the shop counter pointing at a phone while {bhavini} taps, both smiling, Navratri lights behind, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: ત્રણ ગ્રાહકોનું ઉધાર બાકી હતું. એક ટૅપથી યાદ અપાવ્યું. દશેરા પહેલાં બે જણાએ ચૂકવી દીધું.
scenes.sub: Three customers owed her. One tap sent the reminders. Two paid before Dussehra.

scenes.clip: {bhavini} counting the day's cash at the counter of her small Gujarati shop late at night during Navratri, a diya and marigolds by the till, tired but happy, warm lamp light.
scenes.vo: નવ રાત પછી સ્કોર ઉપર. ગલ્લામાં રોકડ પણ. નવરાત્રિ માત્ર ભીડની નહીં, નફાની રહી.
scenes.sub: After nine nights the score is up. So is the cash in the drawer. A Navratri of profit, not just of crowds.

scenes.clip: {bhavini} outside her shop at dawn after Navratri holding a phone with a weekly score rising on it, lights still up, quiet street, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: દર અઠવાડિયે એક નંબર. સો માંથી. અને અઠવાડિયાનાં ત્રણ કામ.
scenes.sub: One number every week, out of 100, and three moves for the week.

scenes.vo: સ્કોર માય બિઝ. તમારા ધંધાની તબિયત જાણો. ત્રીસ દિવસ મફત.

cast.bhavini: Bhavini, a Gujarati woman in her thirties in a mirror-work festive kurta with a long braid
